findings.claim_text: More damaging to the novelty claim, GlobalWafers itself told the Taipei Times in December 2021 that its agreements had lengthened from five years in 2007 to "eight years now," alongside a backlog above NT$100 billion.

Siltronic's chief executive Michael Heckmeier gave the sharpest counter-signal of the three, on 30 July: "What we see today in spot pricing, it's still below LTA level, and it's clearly below reinvest level."
In 2025 area shipments rose 5.8% to 12,973 million square inches while wafer revenue fell 1.2% to $11.4 billion.
